verdict.rationale: QuickBooks docs confirm bank feed import, reconciliation workflow, auto-generated reconciliation report, and discrepancy-focused reports (Reconciliation Discrepancy Report, Missing Checks Report) that help surface issues. However, evidence does not explicitly describe the matched/unmatched/duplicate transaction review UI mechanics that accountants use during reconciliation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the matched/unmatched/duplicate transaction triage screen, independent hands-on confirmation of reconciliation accuracy, and accountant-specific workflow detail beyond marketing copy.
